# MapRange

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Remap a number from one range to another (e.g., map 0-100 to 0-1, or temperature to color intensity).
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/map-range",
  "type": "MapRangeOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/map-range').par.val` (an input) and `op('/map-range').out.scaled` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.val`, `out.scaled`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `val` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `inMin` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `inMax` | `NumberField` | `1` |
| `outMin` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `outMax` | `NumberField` | `1` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|

<!-- gen:end outputs -->
